js.home: const cate=env.get("category");const page=env.get("page");const p=Number(page||1);const url=p<=1?(env.baseUrl+"/anime/ai/"):(env.baseUrl+"/anime/ai/page/"+p+"/");const html=await(0,utils_1.req)(url);const out=[];const seen={};const re=/<a[^>]*href="(\/anime\/ai\/(\d+)\/)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g;let m;while((m=re.exec(html))&&out.length<50){const id=m[2];if(seen[id])continue;seen[id]=1;const inner=m[3];const cm=inner.match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/)||inner.match(/src="([^"]*upload[^"]*)"/);const cover=cm?cm[1]:"";const am=inner.match(/alt="([^"]*)"/);let title=am?am[1]:"";if(!title)title=inner.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").trim();if(title&&title.length>1){out.push({id:"/anime/ai/"+id+"/",title,cover,remark:"AI漫剧"})}}return out

name: 苍穹影视·AI漫剧
desc: 苍穹影视 按原站分类 (含AI漫剧)

js.detail: let id = env.get("movieId", "");if (!id) return { id: "", title: "", cover: "", playlist: [] };const m = String(id).match(/(\d+)/);if (m) id = m[1];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/video/" + id + ".html");const $ = kitty.load(html);let title = $("h1").text().trim();if (!title) title = ($("meta[property=og:title]").attr("content") || "").replace(/^《/, "").replace(/》.*$/, "");let cover = "";$("img").each(function () {const src = $(this).attr("data-original") || "";if (!cover && /(upload|uploads|vod)/.test(src)) cover = src;});let desc = $(".content").text().trim() || $("meta[name=description]").attr("content") || "";desc = desc.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 300);const eps = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const em = href.match(/^\/play\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html$/);if (em && em[1] === String(id)) {const text = $a.text().trim();if (text && text.length < 20) eps.push({ text, id: env.baseUrl + "/play/" + em[1] + "/" + em[2] + "/" + em[3] + ".html" });}});const unique = [];eps.forEach(e => { if (!unique.some(x => x.id === e.id)) unique.push(e); });return { id: "/video/" + id + "/", title, cover, desc, remark: "漫剧", playlist: [{ title: "播放线路", videos: unique }] };
js.search: const wd = env.get("keyword", "");if (!wd) return [];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/search/" + encodeURIComponent(wd) + ".html");const $ = kitty.load(html);const items = [];$("a.cover-img").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/\/video\/(\d+)\.html/);if (m && items.length < 20) {const id = m[1];const title = $a.attr("title") || "";const img = $a.find("img").first();const cover = img.attr("data-original") || img.attr("data-src") || img.attr("src") || "";const key = "/video/" + id + "/";if (title && !items.some(x => x.id === key)) items.push({ id: key, title, cover, remark: "" });}});return items;
js.parseIframe: const iframe = env.get("iframe", "");if (!iframe) return "";const html = await req(iframe);const m = html.match(/player_aaaa\s*=\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*;?\s*<\/script>/);if (m) {try {const cfg = JSON.parse(m[1]);if (cfg.url) return String(cfg.url).replace(/\\\//g, "/");} catch (e) {}}const m2 = html.match(/"url"\s*:\s*"([^"]+\.m3u8[^"]*)"/);if (m2) return m2[1].replace(/\\\//g, "/");return "";
